# Result

`schemas/records/result.json`

One immutable output of a node (docs/design/m0/13 "Model" [G1]). A result is never overwritten. Which result a computation key has selected, and the attempt that produced it (att_), are carried by the graph's result events (G3), not here. Freshness is read from the evidence receipt referenced in value (its valid_until, 06), not from a field of the result (13 [G2]; G4a). The controller computes the outcome from observed facts (13 "Facts, not claims"; the build table is G2's), never from an executor's claim. Only a completed result with outcome found, empty or failed is reusable (13 [G2]); internal/graph checks that a reason fits its outcome (02).

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | [ResultID](common-defs.md#resultid) | The identity of this output, minted by the controller for each output. It is never derived from the computation key. |
| `computation` | yes | [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) | The ComputationKey.key this result answers. |
| `kind` | yes | [ResultKind](common-defs.md#resultkind) |  |
| `value` | yes | array of [ref](records-ref.md) | The output's content, by exact reference (10). Manifests list result ids, never keys (13). A gate or evidence result holds its receipt as exactly one receipt Ref whose content_digest names the receipt blob; the resolver checks that the receipt has the Ref's id and the result's conclusions, then applies it with internal/receipt's Applies (06). |
| `conclusions` | yes | null or object (open payload) | The typed projection used only for reuse decisions (13), one schema per result kind. A gate or evidence result's is its receipt's conclusions, whose RFC 8785 digest is the receipt's conclusions_digest. Only gate and evidence results carry one, since conclusions-only equivalence exists only on the review←gate and review←evidence edges (13 "v1 scope"); every other kind has null. A conclusive gate or evidence result (completed, and found, empty or failed) always has one. |
| `outcome` | yes | [Outcome](common-defs.md#outcome) |  |
| `reason` | yes | [ReasonCode](common-defs.md#reasoncode) |  |
| `detail` | yes | string (maxLength `4096`) | Non-empty for every outcome but empty (02 "Outcome"). |
| `completed` | yes | boolean | Whether execution observably completed: the executor reached a terminal result the controller accepted (05) and reported it found or empty. A reported could_not_run or failed is not completion, nor is a refused or missing result or a lost attempt. An incomplete result is could_not_run, never empty (13 "Facts, not claims"). |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (5, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `outcome` any (not `empty`), `outcome` required, then `detail` any (minLength `1`)
- when `completed` `false`, `completed` required, then `outcome` `could_not_run`
- when `kind` `partial_patch`, `kind` required, then `completed` `false`
- when `kind` any (with a `not` constraint), `kind` required, then `conclusions` `null`
- when `kind` one of `gate_result`, `evidence`, `completed` `true`, `outcome` one of `found`, `empty`, `failed`, `kind` required, `completed` required, `outcome` required, then `conclusions` any (not `null`)
